notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP only (curl_cffi, impersonate=chrome) for the entire pass - robots.txt (User-agent: * / Disallow only on /pages/configurator?*=*) does not block collection/product-listing paths for any tier, so no escalation to Playwright or Claude-in-Chrome was needed. Homepage HTML server-renders the full desktop mega-menu (div[data-megamenu][data-megamenu-menu-point='Shop']) with all category/subcategory links and label text - primary tree source. TREE: union of the server-rendered 'Shop' mega-menu (Kids / Outdoor Living / Accessories / Furniture / Sofas / Lighting / Kitchen / Textiles / Rugs / Certified Products columns) and sitemap_collections_1.xml (182 collection URLs) as cross-check; sitemap-only collections not linked from the mega-menu or any subnav (can-lis-upholstery-fabric = filtered Catena/Rico sofa+pouf modules in one fabric option, i.e. Furniture not Textile; sale-textiles-us, sale-rugs-us etc = Sale/promo landing pages) were excluded as non-navigational/promotional per the Collections rule. QTY: collection pages carry no rendered 'N products' header text or JSON products_count field in the raw HTML (Shopify theme renders count client-side only); used the storage.md Sec.36 fallback - paginated each collection (?page=N, stopped at the page lacking rel='next') and counted unique data-product-handle values per page, summed across pages. Evidence strings below record the per-page breakdown. EXCLUDED: Shelves (/collections/shelves, 71 items: Tilem/Lager/Pilu/Sector/Bon/Kona-Bookcase - designer wall-shelving and bookcase furniture, site places it in the Furniture mega-menu column beside Tables/Chairs/Stools, not beside Storage/Small Storage) and the 'Customize your own shelving system' (Punctual) configurator page - Furniture boundary per storage.md Sec.18/21. Fabric Samples (/collections/fabric-samples, appears under both Furniture and Sofas columns) - swatch/sample products for testing upholstery colour before buying a sofa, not finished textile/furnishing products, excluded consistent with prior project precedent for rug/fabric swatch collections. Hooks and Holders (/collections/hooks-and-holders, 48 items: Lager Coat Rack, Comber/Square wall hooks) - decorative wall hooks and coat racks, not storage containers, excluded per storage.md Sec.19/24. Plant Pots, Plant Boxes, Vases, Mirrors, Candle Holders, Candles, Wallpaper, all Kitchenware (Glasses/Cups/Carafes/Plates/Bowls/Serveware/Kitchen Tools), all Lighting, all seating/tables/sofas/daybeds/poufs/stools, Kids Toys/Furniture/Lamps/Accessories/Wallpaper - excluded as Furniture/Lighting/Kitchen & Dining/Decorative Accessories per each ruleset's boundary sections. Certified Products/Certified Kids Products - cross-cutting sustainability marketing collections, not a genuine product category, excluded. Two Storage rows are flagged MEDIUM/LOW because the site's own named collection mixes genuine storage products with adjacent non-storage items and the exact qty is the site's full displayed collection total (not a filtered pure-storage subset), per the no-aggregation/no-estimation rule: 'Storage' (100 items) includes some furniture-adjacent cabinets/sideboards/bookcase alongside baskets/bins/boxes; 'Small Storage' (152 items) includes decorative glass bowls/trays/centrepieces alongside genuine boxes/containers; 'Bags and Baskets' (16 items) mixes genuine laundry/storage baskets with personal-carry tote/weekend bags (storage.md Sec.6 excludes fashion/carry bags, but the site provides no separate URL to isolate them).
